body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Haier presented its portable WiFi media player 'Rhapsody ibiza Sport' at 2009 CES, which is rugged enough for active people.
Adopting a 2.5-inch LCD display, the Rhapsody ibiza Sport supports music downloads, audio books, photos, automated podcast subscriptions and wireless connection.
Coming in 4GB and 8GB storage capacities, it is expected to be available in 1Q, 2009 for 149(USD) and 169(USD) respectively.
